import { Route, Switch } from "wouter";
import { ClienteDetailContainer } from "../../features/cliente/containers/cliente-detail-container";
import { ClienteFormContainer } from "../../features/cliente/containers/cliente-form-container";
import { ClienteListContainer } from "../../features/cliente/containers/cliente-list-container";
import { HomePage } from "../../pages/home";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../../pages/not-found";
import type { NavEntry } from "../../shared/ui/layout";
import { customRoutes } from "../routes";

export const navEntries: NavEntry[] = [{ label: "Clientes", href: "/clientes" }];

export function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Switch>
      <Route path="/">
        <HomePage entries={navEntries} />
      </Route>
      {customRoutes}
      <Route path="/clientes">
        <ClienteListContainer />
      </Route>
      <Route path="/clientes/new">
        <ClienteFormContainer />
      </Route>
      <Route path="/clientes/:id/edit">{(params) => <ClienteFormContainer id={params.id} />}</Route>
      <Route path="/clientes/:id">{(params) => <ClienteDetailContainer id={params.id} />}</Route>
      <Route>
        <NotFoundPage />
      </Route>
    </Switch>
  );
}
